question: Aruna Asaf Ali is widely remembered for hoisting the Indian National flag during the Quit India Movement in 1942 at the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gowalia Tank Maidan, Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gowalia Tank Maidan**, later renamed **August Kranti Maidan**, is historically significant as the place where Mahatma Gandhi launched the Quit India Movement on August 8, 1942.
 
• It was here that **Aruna Asaf Ali** hoisted the Indian National flag to signal the beginning of one of the largest mass movements against British colonial rule.
 
• Aruna Asaf Ali played a significant role in the movement and was later referred to as the "**Grand Old Lady of Indian Independence**."
 
• The Quit India Movement, also known as the "**Bharat Chhodo Andolan**," was a major civil disobedience movement aimed at ending British rule in India.
 
• The event at Gowalia Tank Maidan symbolized national unity and resistance against British imperialism, making it a landmark in India's struggle for independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Quit India Movement:**

 
 
• Launched by Mahatma Gandhi on August 8, 1942, at the Bombay Session of the All-India Congress Committee, it called for an end to British rule in India.
 
• The movement was marked by mass protests, strikes, and acts of civil disobedience across the country.
 
• Despite widespread arrests and suppression, it laid the foundation for India’s eventual independence in 1947.
